basis: A definitive agreement to sell the International business (item 1.01) gives a levered name (4.5x net secured leverage, a December maturity still needing extension) a path to deleverage. Q4 also showed sequential improvement: North America organic growth, 230bp of adjusted gross-margin expansion and FCF of $58m for the year. The sale price is not in this text, and the unresolved maturity keeps the size moderate in a very volatile stock.
